descriptions.light: Needs regular meals and blood sugar control, but the condition is usually stable.
descriptions.medium: Hunger, stress, or irregular meals can cause weakness, trembling, and a sharp drop in well-being.
descriptions.hard: The condition strongly depends on insulin, food, and water. Without a routine, weakness and confusion appear quickly.
descriptions.veryHard: Requires constant monitoring, a supply of medication, and stable nutrition. Any disruption of the routine quickly worsens the condition.
descriptions.critical: Without insulin, water, or food, may lose consciousness quickly. The condition needs constant support.

descriptions.light: Shortness of breath appears occasionally, especially after exertion or in dusty air.
descriptions.medium: Dust, smoke, cold air, or panic can trigger an attack. Breaks and access to clean air are needed.
descriptions.hard: Attacks can start suddenly. Without medication, breathing quickly becomes difficult.
descriptions.veryHard: Shortness of breath appears even after minor exertion. The condition strongly depends on air quality, rest, and medication.
descriptions.critical: Breathing is unstable even at rest. An attack can quickly become dangerous without help or medication.

descriptions.light: Blood pressure rises during stress or exhaustion, but usually stabilizes quickly.
descriptions.medium: Headache, pulsing sensations, weakness, or ringing in the ears often appear after exertion.
descriptions.hard: Sudden stress, heat, or heavy work can cause a dangerous spike in blood pressure.
descriptions.veryHard: Blood pressure is unstable even at rest. Medication, controlled exertion, and regular rest are needed.
descriptions.critical: A severe pressure spike may come with chest pain, speech problems, weakness, or a risk of stroke.

descriptions.light: Seizures are rare, but the risk rises with lack of sleep, stress, or flashing light.
descriptions.medium: Needs stable sleep, medication, and avoidance of exhaustion. Weakness and disorientation may follow a seizure.
descriptions.hard: May suddenly lose control of the body. After a seizure, time is needed to recover.
descriptions.veryHard: Seizures happen more often, exhaust the body, and may cause injuries during falls.
descriptions.critical: Seizures may be prolonged or repeat without proper recovery. Constant supervision and medication are needed.

en.name: Blindness
en.description: Cannot see or can barely see. Navigates through hearing, spatial memory, touch, and supporting cues.

en.name: Deafness
en.description: Cannot hear or can barely hear sounds, voice commands, and alarm signals. Understands information better through gestures, text, or visual signs.

en.name: Amputated Arm
en.description: One arm is missing or does not function. Actions requiring strength, grip, or precise two-handed work are difficult.

en.name: Amputated Leg
en.description: One leg is missing or does not function. Movement depends on a prosthesis, crutches, support, or assistance.

en.name: Paralysis of the Lower Limbs
en.description: Cannot move the legs normally. Movement depends on a wheelchair, flat surfaces, accessible passages, or outside help.

descriptions.light: Joint pain and stiffness appear occasionally, especially after cold exposure or long periods of sitting.
descriptions.medium: Movements become slower, joints hurt after exertion, and standing for long periods or working with the hands becomes difficult.
descriptions.hard: Pain is frequent and noticeably limits movement. Breaks, warmth, pain relief, or help with heavy actions are needed.
descriptions.veryHard: Joints are heavily inflamed, movement is difficult, and pain may persist even at rest.

descriptions.light: Bones are more fragile than normal, but the condition is barely noticeable during calm activity.
descriptions.medium: A fall, impact, or sudden movement can easily cause a crack or fracture.
descriptions.hard: Back or bone pain appears more often, movements become cautious, and the risk of fractures is high.
descriptions.veryHard: Even a minor injury can lead to a serious fracture. Caution is needed with every movement.

descriptions.light: Cough, weakness, and sweating appear from time to time. The condition requires monitoring.
descriptions.medium: The cough becomes more frequent, exhaustion and fever appear, and there is a risk of infecting others.
descriptions.hard: Severe cough, weakness, and weight loss noticeably drain the body. Medication, rest, and contact control are needed.
descriptions.veryHard: Breathing becomes harder, the body weakens quickly, and the infection may progress actively without treatment.
descriptions.critical: Coughing blood, severe weakness, and dangerous breathing deterioration are possible. Isolation and urgent medical support are needed.

descriptions.light: The immune system is slightly weakened, but the body handles infections and exhaustion worse.
descriptions.medium: Colds, weakness, or slow recovery after illness happen more often.
descriptions.hard: Immune defense is noticeably reduced. Even a common infection may last longer or cause complications.
descriptions.veryHard: The body struggles to fight infections. Cleanliness, medication, contact control, and stable nutrition are needed.
descriptions.critical: The immune system is critically weakened. Any serious infection can quickly become dangerous.

descriptions.light: Weakness, heaviness in the right side, or poor tolerance of fatty food appears periodically.
descriptions.medium: Fatigue comes faster, with possible nausea, loss of appetite, and worse well-being after poor-quality food.
descriptions.hard: The liver works unstably. Caution with medication, diet, and avoiding overload are needed.
descriptions.veryHard: Weakness, nausea, and exhaustion occur often. The body handles infections, hunger, and toxins worse.
descriptions.critical: Signs of liver failure are possible: severe weakness, jaundice, confusion, or sudden deterioration.

descriptions.light: Cough, shortness of breath, or quick fatigue appear, but the condition still allows a normal rhythm.
descriptions.medium: Cough, chest pain, and weakness become more noticeable. Exertion quickly drains strength.
descriptions.hard: Breathing is difficult, strength runs out quickly, and pain or weight loss may appear.
descriptions.veryHard: Shortness of breath appears even with small movements. The body is exhausted and handles infections worse.
descriptions.critical: Severe shortness of breath, coughing blood, sharp pain, or a dangerous drop in strength are possible.

descriptions.light: The back aches after long sitting, cold exposure, or exertion, but the pain is usually tolerable.
descriptions.medium: Pain becomes more frequent, and standing for long periods, bending, or carrying weight becomes difficult.
descriptions.hard: Movements become cautious; pain may radiate into the leg or worsen after a sudden movement.
descriptions.veryHard: Pain is almost constant, and the back quickly locks up from exertion or an uncomfortable position.

descriptions.light: Severe headaches appear from time to time, often after stress, lack of sleep, or bright light.
descriptions.medium: Attacks come with nausea, light sensitivity, or sensitivity to noise. Quiet and rest are needed.
descriptions.hard: During an attack, it is difficult to concentrate, move, or react to events.
descriptions.veryHard: Attacks are long and exhausting. Weakness, brain fog, or vision disturbances may remain afterward.

descriptions.light: Shortness of breath and fatigue appear faster after exertion, but the condition is stable at rest.
descriptions.medium: Even moderate exertion causes palpitations, weakness, or lack of air.
descriptions.hard: Shortness of breath, swelling, and fatigue become frequent. Medication, a calm pace, and condition control are needed.
descriptions.veryHard: Weakness and lack of air appear even during minor actions or long standing.
descriptions.critical: Sudden breathing difficulty, chest pain, severe weakness, or the threat of a heart attack are possible.

descriptions.light: Requires control of diet, but usually does not cause sharp symptoms.
descriptions.medium: After hunger, sweet food, or stress, drowsiness, weakness, and sudden energy swings may appear.
descriptions.hard: Glucose metabolism is unstable. Regular food, water, and avoiding sudden exertion are needed.

descriptions.light: The leg hurts while walking, movements are cautious, and full weight-bearing is undesirable.
descriptions.medium: Walking causes strong pain, support or fixation is needed. A second injury can worsen the fracture.
descriptions.hard: The bone cannot handle normal load. Pain, swelling, and instability interfere with movement.
descriptions.veryHard: Any wrong movement can displace the fracture. Rigid fixation, rest, and pain relief are needed.

descriptions.light: The arm hurts under load, grip is weaker, and some movements are limited.
descriptions.medium: Pain increases when trying to lift things or work with the hands. Fixation is needed.
descriptions.hard: The bone is still unstable, and movement is sharply limited. Any load can injure the arm again.
descriptions.veryHard: The arm can barely move without pain. Rigid fixation, rest, and caution are needed.

descriptions.light: The shoulder hurts when raising the arm, and movement is limited and cautious.
descriptions.medium: The joint is unstable, and a sudden movement can dislocate the shoulder again. Fixation and rest are needed.
descriptions.hard: The arm barely works because of pain and shoulder instability. Numbness or weakness in the hand is possible.

descriptions.light: The knee hurts after exertion, with occasional feelings of instability.
descriptions.medium: The knee may buckle while walking or turning. Fixation and careful movement are needed.
descriptions.hard: Strong pain and instability make normal walking difficult. Swelling worsens after exertion.
descriptions.veryHard: The knee barely supports body weight. Any sudden movement can worsen the injury.

descriptions.light: Headache, dizziness, or sensitivity to noise appears periodically.
descriptions.medium: Concentration worsens, with possible nausea, fatigue, short memory lapses, or disorientation.
descriptions.hard: Sudden movements, stress, or lack of sleep worsen symptoms. Reaction and attention are unstable.
descriptions.veryHard: Dizziness, headache, and confusion can return in waves. Rest and condition monitoring are needed.

descriptions.light: The skin hurts, reddens, and forms blisters. Cleanliness and caution are needed.
descriptions.medium: Pain is strong, and a large area of skin is damaged. There is a risk of infection and fluid loss.
descriptions.hard: The burns are highly exhausting, movement is painful, and wounds need regular care and dressings.
descriptions.veryHard: Damaged skin protects the body poorly. The risk of dehydration, infection, and severe pain is high.
descriptions.critical: Shock, infection, or dangerous fluid loss are possible. Clean dressings, water, and urgent care are needed.

descriptions.light: Penicillin may cause a rash, itching, or mild worsening of well-being.
descriptions.medium: The reaction may include swelling, a severe rash, or difficulty breathing.
descriptions.hard: Penicillin can cause a sudden allergic reaction. This drug must be avoided and alternatives are needed.
descriptions.critical: Contact with penicillin can cause anaphylaxis: throat swelling, a drop in blood pressure, and a threat to life.

descriptions.light: Nuts cause itching, rash, or discomfort, so food ingredients must be checked.
descriptions.medium: Even a small amount of nuts can cause swelling, nausea, or severe weakness.
descriptions.hard: The reaction can be sudden and fast. Complete avoidance of nuts and readiness for an attack are needed.
descriptions.critical: Contact with the allergen can cause anaphylaxis: difficulty breathing, swelling, and a sharp drop in blood pressure.

descriptions.light: Bloating, pain, or weakness may appear after eating food with gluten.
descriptions.medium: Bread, wheat, and many grains must be avoided. Mistakes in food quickly worsen well-being.
descriptions.hard: Gluten causes severe pain, diarrhea, loss of strength, and poor nutrient absorption.
descriptions.veryHard: The body poorly tolerates most common grain products. Without a suitable diet, weakness develops quickly.

descriptions.light: Abdominal pain, bloating, or unstable digestion appears occasionally.
descriptions.medium: Frequent pain, diarrhea, and loss of strength depend on food, stress, and access to water.
descriptions.hard: Intestinal inflammation often flares up. Strong cramps, exhaustion, and poor food absorption are possible.
descriptions.veryHard: Flares are long and painful, and the body quickly loses water and strength.
descriptions.critical: Bleeding, severe dehydration, or dangerous intestinal inflammation are possible. Urgent help is needed.

descriptions.light: Burning, pain, and nausea may appear after eating or during hunger.
descriptions.medium: Pain becomes more frequent, and caution with food, stress, and medication is needed.
descriptions.hard: Severe pain, nausea, and weakness can worsen sharply after hunger or irritating food.
descriptions.veryHard: Pain lasts a long time, food is poorly tolerated, and vomiting or severe weakness may appear.
descriptions.critical: Internal bleeding or ulcer perforation is possible. Signs include sharp pain, black stool, vomiting blood, or weakness.

en.name: Severe Nearsightedness (-8)
en.description: Sees distant objects very poorly without glasses or lenses. In dim light, dust, or stress, orientation becomes even worse.

en.name: Severe Farsightedness (+6)
en.description: Sees poorly up close without glasses or lenses. Reading small text, working with details, and prolonged eye strain quickly cause fatigue.

en.name: Color Blindness
en.description: Has trouble distinguishing some colors. May confuse colored signals, markings, wires, indicators, or warning labels.

descriptions.light: Runny nose, cough, body aches, and weakness appear, but the fever is mild.
descriptions.medium: Fever, muscle pain, and strong fatigue interfere with normal movement and concentration.
descriptions.hard: High fever, chills, and cough quickly drain the body. Sleep, water, and symptom control are needed.
descriptions.veryHard: Severe fever, weakness, and shortness of breath may come in waves. The body handles exertion poorly.
descriptions.critical: Complications affecting the lungs or heart, severe dehydration, or confusion are possible. Urgent support of the condition is needed.

descriptions.light: Feels like a cold: cough, weakness, sore throat, or loss of smell.
descriptions.medium: Fever, body aches, cough, and exhaustion noticeably reduce strength. Rest and breathing control are needed.
descriptions.hard: Breathing becomes harder, weakness lasts longer, and exertion quickly worsens well-being.
descriptions.veryHard: Shortness of breath appears even with small movements. Clean air, rest, and constant observation are needed.
descriptions.critical: A sharp lack of oxygen, confusion, bluish lips, or dangerous breathing deterioration are possible.

descriptions.light: Cough and weakness are already noticeable, but breathing at rest is mostly stable.
descriptions.medium: Fever, chest pain, phlegm, and quick fatigue appear.
descriptions.hard: Breathing is difficult, coughing is painful, and the body exhausts quickly. Medication, water, and rest are needed.
descriptions.veryHard: Even brief movement causes shortness of breath. Severe fever, chest pain, and lack of oxygen are possible.
descriptions.critical: The lungs may fail to handle breathing. Bluish skin, confusion, sudden weakness, or the threat of respiratory failure are possible.

descriptions.light: May show as an ulcer, rash, or swollen lymph nodes, sometimes with almost no pain.
descriptions.medium: Rash, weakness, and general inflammation may return in waves. Medication and condition monitoring are needed.
descriptions.hard: Without treatment, the infection can affect the skin, nerves, eyes, or internal organs.
descriptions.veryHard: Coordination, vision, memory, or organs may be severely affected after a long course.

descriptions.light: May cause burning, pain, or discharge, but overall condition is barely affected.
descriptions.medium: Pain and inflammation increase, with possible discomfort during movement, fever, or urination.
descriptions.hard: The infection can spread further, causing severe pain, fever, or complications.
descriptions.veryHard: Inflammation becomes systemic: weakness, fever, joint pain, or risk of internal organ involvement.

descriptions.light: Attacks of fever, chills, and sweating appear periodically, with possible stabilization between them.
descriptions.medium: Fever returns in waves, draining strength and causing headache, weakness, and trembling.
descriptions.hard: Severe fever attacks, anemia, and dehydration quickly drain strength.
descriptions.veryHard: Attacks become severe and frequent. Confusion, jaundice, severe weakness, or breathing problems are possible.
descriptions.critical: Cerebral malaria, seizures, coma, or organ failure are possible. Urgent medical help is needed.

descriptions.light: Muscles become tenser than usual, and a wound may hurt or heal poorly.
descriptions.medium: Spasms of the jaw, neck, or back appear. Movements become painful and stiff.
descriptions.hard: Convulsions may be triggered by sound, light, or touch. Breathing and swallowing become difficult.
descriptions.veryHard: Severe spasms repeat, the body suddenly tightens, and injuries or exhaustion are possible.
descriptions.critical: Convulsions can disrupt breathing or heart function. Quiet, medication, and urgent medical support are needed.

descriptions.light: After a bite, pain, tingling, or an unusual sensation appears at the wound site.
descriptions.medium: Fever, anxiety, insomnia, headache, and unusual sensitivity to stimuli are possible.
descriptions.hard: The condition worsens quickly: spasms, fear of water, panic, or swallowing problems appear.
descriptions.veryHard: The nervous system fails sharply. Aggression, delirium, paralysis, or attacks are possible.
descriptions.critical: Once symptoms develop, the condition is almost always fatal without special help. Seizures, paralysis, and respiratory arrest are possible.

descriptions.light: Fever, weakness, and painful swollen lymph nodes appear.
descriptions.medium: Fever is high, node pain is severe, and movement or touch becomes painful.
descriptions.hard: The infection quickly drains the body; delirium, severe pain, vomiting, or dark skin spots are possible.
descriptions.veryHard: The condition may progress into blood infection or a lung form. Weakness and fever become dangerous.
descriptions.critical: Sepsis, shock, bleeding, or sudden lung damage are possible. Isolation and urgent medical help are needed.

descriptions.light: Cough appears often, especially after cold air, dust, or in the morning.
descriptions.medium: The cough becomes prolonged, mucus gets thicker, and breathing is disrupted faster by exertion.
descriptions.hard: Flare-ups cause severe cough, weakness, and lack of air. Clean air and rest are needed.
descriptions.veryHard: Breathing is difficult even after small movements, and coughing exhausts the body and may prevent normal sleep.

descriptions.light: Shortness of breath appears quickly after exertion, but breathing at rest is still relatively even.
descriptions.medium: The lungs release air poorly, exhaling becomes harder, and strength runs out quickly.
descriptions.hard: Shortness of breath is frequent, as if the chest cannot fully exhale. Breaks and clean air are needed.
descriptions.veryHard: Breathing is difficult even at rest. Any dust, smoke, or cold air sharply worsens the condition.
descriptions.critical: Respiratory failure is possible: severe shortness of breath, bluish skin, panic, or confusion from lack of oxygen.

descriptions.light: The kidneys work worse, and swelling, fatigue, or changes in urination appear faster.
descriptions.medium: The body removes excess fluid and toxins worse. Water, diet, and medication control are needed.
descriptions.hard: Swelling, weakness, nausea, and high blood pressure become frequent. The condition depends on routine and treatment.
descriptions.veryHard: Toxins accumulate, with possible confusion, itching, shortness of breath, severe weakness, and heart rhythm disturbances.
descriptions.critical: Kidney failure with dangerous buildup of toxins and fluid is possible. Urgent medical support is needed.

descriptions.light: Pain in the side or lower back appears periodically, especially after not drinking enough water.
descriptions.medium: Pain may come in waves, radiate to the lower abdomen, and come with nausea or blood in the urine.
descriptions.hard: Severe kidney colic sharply limits movement. Water, pain relief, and rest are needed.
descriptions.veryHard: A stone may block urine flow. Pain is very strong, with possible fever, weakness, and risk of infection.

descriptions.light: After fatty food, heaviness, nausea, or pain under the right ribs may appear.
descriptions.medium: Pain attacks become more frequent and may come with vomiting and weakness.
descriptions.hard: Biliary colic causes sharp pain that may last for hours. Rest and caution with food are needed.
descriptions.veryHard: A stone may block the bile ducts. Jaundice, fever, and severe pain are possible.

descriptions.light: The liver works worse, and weakness, nausea, or heaviness after food appears faster.
descriptions.medium: Fatigue, swelling, bruises, and poor tolerance of medication or toxins become more noticeable.
descriptions.hard: Jaundice, bleeding, weight loss, and fluid buildup in the abdomen are possible.
descriptions.veryHard: The liver cleans the blood poorly. Confusion, severe weakness, bleeding, or sudden swelling are possible.
descriptions.critical: Liver failure is possible: coma, massive bleeding, infection, or dangerous fluid buildup.

descriptions.light: Mild tremor, stiffness, or slowed movement appears.
descriptions.medium: Movements become slower, hands shake more, and starting movement or precise finger work becomes harder.
descriptions.hard: Stiffness, tremor, and balance problems noticeably interfere with movement. Breaks and a stable medication routine are needed.
descriptions.veryHard: The body often freezes, balance is unstable, and speech or swallowing may worsen.

descriptions.light: Numbness, weakness, tremor, or vision problems appear occasionally.
descriptions.medium: Symptoms return in waves: fatigue, unsteady gait, limb weakness, or coordination problems.
descriptions.hard: Movement and sensation are noticeably impaired. Overheating, stress, or infection can sharply worsen the condition.
descriptions.veryHard: Weakness, spasms, vision problems, and coordination issues can last a long time and strongly limit independent movement.

descriptions.light: Fatigue, paleness, or dizziness appears faster after exertion.
descriptions.medium: Weakness, palpitations, and shortness of breath occur even after moderate actions.
descriptions.hard: Organs lack oxygen. Fainting, severe weakness, cold hands, and brain fog are possible.
descriptions.veryHard: Strength runs out quickly even at rest, pulse is fast, and dizziness is frequent.
descriptions.critical: Dangerous lack of oxygen in tissues is possible: fainting, chest pain, confusion, or a sudden drop in strength.

descriptions.light: After cuts or impacts, bleeding stops more slowly and bruises appear more easily.
descriptions.medium: Even a small injury can cause prolonged bleeding or painful joint swelling.
descriptions.hard: Bleeding may start after minimal damage. Pressure on wounds, dressings, and caution are needed.
descriptions.veryHard: Internal bleeding into joints or muscles, severe pain, and sharply limited movement are possible.
descriptions.critical: Head or abdominal trauma, or a deep cut, can cause dangerous internal bleeding.

descriptions.light: Weakness, paleness, frequent bruises, or a tendency toward infections appear.
descriptions.medium: Immunity and blood formation are more disrupted: frequent colds, bleeding, fatigue, and bone pain.
descriptions.hard: The body fights infections, bleeding, and exhaustion poorly. Medication, cleanliness, and rest are needed.
descriptions.veryHard: Weakness, fever, bruises, and infections may persist constantly. The risk of complications is high.
descriptions.critical: Dangerous bleeding, sepsis, a sharp drop in strength, or failure of blood formation are possible.

en.name: Pregnancy (8th Month)
en.description: Late-stage pregnancy. Fatigue, back pain, swelling, shortness of breath, and the need for regular rest appear faster.

descriptions.light: Fatigue appears faster than usual, especially after stress or lack of sleep.
descriptions.medium: After ordinary actions, longer recovery is needed. Brain fog, muscle pain, and poor sleep are possible.
descriptions.hard: Even minor exertion can cause a sharp drop in strength for several hours or days.
descriptions.veryHard: Exhaustion is almost constant. Sleep does not restore strength, and concentration and movement are often slowed.

descriptions.light: Muscles and joints hurt periodically, especially after cold exposure, stress, or lack of sleep.
descriptions.medium: Pain spreads through the body, sleep worsens, and fatigue and sensitivity to touch appear.
descriptions.hard: Pain is frequent and exhausting, movement becomes harder, and concentration worsens.
descriptions.veryHard: Pain is almost constant, and the body reacts sharply to cold, noise, stress, and overexertion.

descriptions.light: The lower back hurts sharply after bending, lifting weight, or an awkward movement.
descriptions.medium: Pain forces slow movement, and bending, standing up, or standing for long periods becomes difficult.
descriptions.hard: The lower back can feel locked. Sudden movement increases pain; warmth, rest, and pain relief are needed.
descriptions.veryHard: Severe pain blocks normal movement, may radiate into the leg, and returns with the slightest load.

descriptions.light: Back or neck pain sometimes radiates into an arm or leg, especially after exertion.
descriptions.medium: Burning, shooting pain, and numbness worsen during walking, bending, or sitting.
descriptions.hard: The nerve is strongly irritated: pain is sharp, movements are cautious, and weakness or tingling in the limb is possible.
descriptions.veryHard: Pain almost prevents normal movement, and numbness and weakness may last a long time.

descriptions.light: The back hurts after exertion or long sitting, and pain sometimes radiates into the leg.
descriptions.medium: Pain, numbness, or weakness worsens when bending, lifting weight, or moving suddenly.
descriptions.hard: The nerve is compressed more strongly: movements are limited, and pain may be sharp and long-lasting.
descriptions.veryHard: Severe pain, numbness, or limb weakness may persist even at rest. Caution and symptom control are needed.

descriptions.light: The spine is slightly curved, and back fatigue sometimes appears after long standing or sitting.
descriptions.medium: Posture is noticeably affected, the back tires faster, and pain after exertion is possible.
descriptions.hard: The curvature affects movement, breathing, or endurance. Back pain appears more often.
descriptions.veryHard: Severe spinal curvature may press on the chest, limit breathing, and cause constant pain.

descriptions.light: Sharp joint pain appears occasionally, most often in the foot or big toe.
descriptions.medium: Pain attacks become stronger, the joint reddens, swells, and hurts even from light touch.
descriptions.hard: During a flare-up, the pain is sharp and burning, movement is strongly limited, and rest, water, and anti-inflammatory medication are needed.
descriptions.veryHard: Attacks may last for days, joints may deform, or pain may become almost constant.

descriptions.light: Joints sometimes hurt and feel stiff, especially in the morning or after cold exposure.
descriptions.medium: Inflammation returns more often, fingers and hands hurt, and fine movements become harder.
descriptions.hard: Joints swell, movement is painful, and grip strength decreases. Warmth, breaks, and medication are needed.
descriptions.veryHard: Inflammation can last a long time, joints may deform, and pain may appear even at rest.

descriptions.light: Dry red patches appear on the skin, itching and flaking.
descriptions.medium: Affected areas become larger, the skin cracks, and itching or burning interferes with rest.
descriptions.hard: Inflammation covers large areas, cracks may bleed, and the risk of irritation and infection increases.
descriptions.veryHard: The skin constantly hurts, flakes, and cracks; joint involvement and severe exhaustion from itching are possible.

descriptions.light: The skin periodically becomes dry, itchy, and red after cold, stress, or irritants.
descriptions.medium: Itching becomes more frequent, the skin cracks, and weeping or painful areas appear.
descriptions.hard: Inflammation interferes with sleep and hand use; cracks become easily contaminated.
descriptions.veryHard: The skin is severely damaged, itching is almost constant, and infections or painful open areas are possible.

descriptions.light: Body weight is far above normal, and shortness of breath or fatigue appears faster after movement.
descriptions.medium: The strain on the heart, joints, and back is noticeable, and movements become slower.
descriptions.hard: Shortness of breath, knee pain, sweating, and high blood pressure often appear after minor exertion.
descriptions.veryHard: Movement is sharply limited, the heart and breathing overload quickly, and swelling or sleep problems are possible.
descriptions.critical: Dangerous attacks of shortness of breath, a sharp blood pressure rise, chest pain, or an acute cardiovascular complication are possible.

descriptions.light: Body weight is low, and cold, weakness, and fatigue appear quickly.
descriptions.medium: The body lacks energy; dizziness, brittle hair, and poor tolerance of cold are possible.
descriptions.hard: Muscles weaken, heartbeat becomes unstable, and exertion may cause trembling or fainting.
descriptions.veryHard: Severe exhaustion, low blood pressure, impaired body temperature regulation, and dangerous weakness become constant.
descriptions.critical: Arrhythmia, fainting, organ failure, or sudden deterioration from lack of nutrients are possible.

en.name: Dwarfism
en.description: Has very short stature due to bone development or hormonal features. Shorter limbs, faster joint fatigue, and a need for adapted objects are possible.

descriptions.light: Height and body size are far above normal, so joints and the back tire faster.
descriptions.medium: Pain appears in the knees, back, or feet, and standing for long periods or moving in tight spaces becomes harder.
descriptions.hard: The heart, joints, and spine are constantly overloaded; headache, weakness, and swelling are possible.
descriptions.veryHard: Large body size places heavy strain on the heart, breathing, and joints; pain and fatigue occur often.

descriptions.light: The body is tall and flexible, joints are less stable, and back or chest pain appears sometimes.
descriptions.medium: Ligaments are easily overloaded; vision problems, palpitations, or chest pain are possible.
descriptions.hard: The heart, blood vessels, and joints require caution. Sudden exertion can cause pain or weakness.
descriptions.veryHard: Blood vessels may be fragile, vision and joints are unstable, and physical overexertion becomes dangerous.
descriptions.critical: Aortic dissection is possible: sharp chest or back pain, weakness, falling blood pressure, and threat to life.

en.name: Down Syndrome
en.description: A congenital developmental condition that may affect muscle tone, coordination, learning pace, speech, and sometimes heart or thyroid function.

en.name: Albinism
en.description: The skin, hair, and eyes have little pigment. Bright light is harder to tolerate, the skin burns quickly, and vision is often sensitive to brightness.

en.name: Vitiligo
en.description: Has light patches of skin without pigment. They are more sensitive to sun exposure and irritation and need protection from burns.

descriptions.light: Speech sometimes breaks, especially during anxiety or hurry.
descriptions.medium: Repetitions, pauses, and speech blocks become more noticeable, and stress sharply worsens pronunciation.
descriptions.hard: Words may get stuck for a long time, breathing is disrupted, and speaking quickly or under pressure is very difficult.
descriptions.veryHard: Speech often blocks, and even a simple phrase may require time, calm, and concentration.

descriptions.light: Sometimes it is difficult to find a word or quickly form a thought.
descriptions.medium: Speech becomes confused, some words are replaced with wrong ones, and complex instructions are harder to understand.
descriptions.hard: Speaking and understanding long phrases is difficult. Short sentences, gestures, or written hints are needed.
descriptions.veryHard: Speech is severely impaired; the person may understand more than they can say. Communication requires time.
descriptions.critical: Can barely speak or understand speech normally. Signs of severe brain damage may be present.

descriptions.light: Ringing or noise appears in the ears periodically, especially in silence.
descriptions.medium: The noise becomes more frequent and interferes with sleep, concentration, or hearing quiet sounds.
descriptions.hard: Constant ringing is exhausting and may cause headache, irritability, and sleep disturbance.
descriptions.veryHard: The noise almost never disappears, masks some sounds, and heavily exhausts the nervous system.

descriptions.light: A spinning sensation appears sometimes, especially after quickly turning the head.
descriptions.medium: Dizziness comes with nausea, unstable walking, and the need to stop.
descriptions.hard: Attacks can suddenly break balance, cause vomiting, and create fear of movement.
descriptions.veryHard: The world feels like it is spinning even at rest, and standing or walking is difficult without support.
descriptions.critical: Falls, severe vomiting, dehydration, or possible acute damage to the brain or inner ear may occur.

descriptions.light: Ear noise, fullness, and mild dizziness appear occasionally.
descriptions.medium: Vertigo attacks repeat, hearing fluctuates, and nausea or unstable walking is possible.
descriptions.hard: Severe attacks disrupt balance, cause vomiting, and temporarily worsen hearing.
descriptions.veryHard: Dizziness may last for hours, hearing is noticeably reduced, and ear noise is almost constant.

descriptions.light: The field of vision gradually narrows, and pressure or pain in the eyes sometimes appears.
descriptions.medium: Peripheral vision worsens, light may create halos, and the eyes tire quickly.
descriptions.hard: Vision is noticeably limited, with possible pain, foggy sight, and orientation difficulties.
descriptions.veryHard: The field of vision is sharply narrowed, parts of space drop out, and constant eye pressure control is needed.
descriptions.critical: An acute attack can cause severe eye pain, nausea, sudden vision loss, and risk of blindness.

descriptions.light: Vision is slightly cloudy, bright light dazzles more, and contrast decreases.
descriptions.medium: Objects look blurred, and reading, recognizing faces, or seeing in dim light becomes harder.
descriptions.hard: Vision is heavily clouded, light creates glare, and small details are almost invisible.
descriptions.veryHard: The eye sees very unclearly; outlines and movement are recognized poorly, and orientation depends on lighting.

descriptions.light: Flashes, floaters, or dark spots appear in the field of vision.
descriptions.medium: Part of vision seems covered by a shadow, outlines distort, and orientation worsens.
descriptions.hard: A dark curtain spreads quickly across the field of vision, and sight may fall within hours or days.
descriptions.critical: Rapid irreversible vision loss is possible without urgent treatment.

descriptions.light: The nose is often blocked, pressure appears around the cheeks or forehead, and smell weakens.
descriptions.medium: Sinus pain, thick discharge, and headache return after cold exposure or infections.
descriptions.hard: Inflammation lasts a long time, the face hurts, nasal breathing is difficult, and sleep worsens.
descriptions.veryHard: Purulent inflammation can cause severe pain, fever, facial swelling, and sharp exhaustion.

descriptions.light: Sleep is restless, and morning fatigue or dry mouth often appears.
descriptions.medium: Breathing stops during sleep, causing daytime sleepiness, headache, and poor concentration.
descriptions.hard: Night breathing pauses are frequent, the heart and blood pressure are overloaded, and sleep restores little strength.
descriptions.veryHard: Sleep almost does not restore strength; sudden awakenings with lack of air and severe daytime sleepiness are possible.
descriptions.critical: Dangerous heart rhythm disturbances, sharp drops in oxygen at night, or complications with blood pressure and the heart are possible.

descriptions.light: Fatigue appears faster than usual, especially after stress or lack of sleep.
descriptions.medium: After ordinary actions, longer recovery is needed, and sleep does not always restore strength.
descriptions.hard: Even minor exertion can cause a sharp drop in strength, muscle pain, and brain fog.
descriptions.veryHard: Exhaustion is almost constant, concentration is weak, and the body recovers slowly after any activity.

descriptions.light: Metabolism is slowed, so cold, sleepiness, and fatigue appear faster.
descriptions.medium: Swelling, weight gain, slowed reactions, dry skin, and reduced endurance are possible.
descriptions.hard: Weakness, chilliness, and sluggishness are noticeable almost every day. Hormones and a stable routine are needed.
descriptions.veryHard: The body works very slowly: severe sleepiness, swelling, low body temperature, and confusion may increase.
descriptions.critical: Myxedema crisis is possible: sudden body cooling, confusion, slow breathing, and threat to life.

descriptions.light: Metabolism is accelerated, with more frequent sweating, trembling, and palpitations.
descriptions.medium: Pulse is high, weight may drop, hands tremble, and heat or stress is tolerated worse.
descriptions.hard: The heart is overloaded, with possible weakness, anxiety, insomnia, and sudden condition swings.
descriptions.veryHard: Tremor, tachycardia, exhaustion, and heat intolerance become almost constant.
descriptions.critical: Thyroid storm is possible: very high pulse, fever, delirium, vomiting, and danger to the heart.

descriptions.light: The heart rhythm sometimes skips, with brief palpitations or pauses.
descriptions.medium: Palpitation attacks come with weakness, shortness of breath, or anxiety.
descriptions.hard: The rhythm is unstable, with possible dizziness, chest pain, or near-fainting.
descriptions.veryHard: Attacks are prolonged, the pulse is very irregular, strength falls quickly, and monitoring and medication are needed.
descriptions.critical: A dangerous arrhythmia with fainting, chest pain, sharp weakness, or cardiac arrest is possible.

descriptions.light: Palpitations, chest discomfort, or mild weakness appear sometimes.
descriptions.medium: Stress and exertion can cause heart rhythm interruptions, shortness of breath, or dizziness.
descriptions.hard: The valve works less stably, with possible chest pain, fatigue, and a feeling of lack of air.
descriptions.veryHard: The heart handles exertion worse, and rhythm disturbances and weakness may repeat often.

descriptions.light: Chest pain or pressure appears after strong stress or exertion.
descriptions.medium: Pain attacks become more frequent and may radiate into the arm, neck, or jaw.
descriptions.hard: Chest pain appears even after moderate actions, with shortness of breath and fear.
descriptions.veryHard: Chest pressure may appear almost at rest, and medication and pulse control are needed.
descriptions.critical: An attack may turn into a heart attack: prolonged chest pain, cold sweat, nausea, weakness, or shortness of breath.

descriptions.light: After a heart attack, fatigue appears faster and the heart handles sudden exertion worse.
descriptions.medium: Shortness of breath, palpitations, weakness, and fear of another attack may appear after stress.
descriptions.hard: The heart has reduced reserve, and exertion or lack of sleep may cause chest pain and sharp weakness.
descriptions.veryHard: Even small actions can cause shortness of breath, chest pressure, and an unstable pulse.
descriptions.critical: A repeat heart attack or acute heart failure is possible: severe pain, cold sweat, shortness of breath, and loss of strength.

descriptions.light: Leg veins are enlarged, and heaviness and swelling appear after long standing.
descriptions.medium: Legs tire quickly, veins hurt, and swelling worsens by evening.
descriptions.hard: Cramps, vein inflammation, skin discoloration, and pain while walking are possible.
descriptions.veryHard: Swelling and pain occur often, the skin over the veins becomes thin, and ulcers may appear.
descriptions.critical: Thrombosis or thromboembolism is possible: sudden pain, swelling, leg redness, or sudden shortness of breath.

descriptions.light: A vein hurts and slightly swells, and the skin over it may feel warm or look red.
descriptions.medium: Pain and swelling worsen after walking or long standing. The leg tires faster.
descriptions.hard: The inflamed vein is painful and firm to the touch, and swelling lasts longer. Rest and condition control are needed.
descriptions.veryHard: Swelling, pain, and redness are severe, movement is limited, and inflammation may spread along the vein.
descriptions.critical: A clot may break loose: sudden shortness of breath, chest pain, coughing blood, or sharp weakness.

descriptions.light: Discomfort in the lower abdomen, frequent urination, or pulling pain appears periodically.
descriptions.medium: Pain and burning worsen after cold exposure, stress, or long sitting. Sleep may be interrupted by bathroom trips.
descriptions.hard: Inflammation flares often, with possible fever, sharp pain, weakness, and urination problems.
descriptions.veryHard: Pain lasts a long time, urination is painful or difficult, and flare-ups are strongly exhausting.

descriptions.light: Pulling pain in the lower abdomen appears periodically, especially before or during menstruation.
descriptions.medium: Pain becomes stronger, may radiate to the back or legs, and weakness or nausea appears.
descriptions.hard: Cramps and bleeding are exhausting, and pain may appear outside the cycle and interfere with movement.
descriptions.veryHard: Pain is long-lasting and severe, with possible heavy bleeding, anemia, dizziness, and a sharp drop in strength.

descriptions.light: May cause heaviness in the lower abdomen, discomfort, or an irregular cycle.
descriptions.medium: Bleeding becomes heavier, with pain, weakness, or pressure on the bladder.
descriptions.hard: Heavy bleeding may cause anemia, dizziness, and quick fatigue.
descriptions.veryHard: Pain, pressure, and bleeding occur often, with possible severe weakness and poor recovery after blood loss.
descriptions.critical: Dangerous bleeding is possible, with sharp weakness, paleness, dizziness, or fainting.

en.name: Infertility
en.description: Cannot have children naturally or has very low reproductive ability. Overall physical condition may still be normal.

descriptions.light: Erection problems occur occasionally, more often after stress, fatigue, or illness.
descriptions.medium: Problems repeat often and may come with anxiety, reduced libido, or hormonal issues.
descriptions.hard: An erection is almost impossible to maintain without treatment. Related vascular, nerve, or endocrine problems are possible.

descriptions.light: Itching, discomfort, or mild pain appears periodically after sitting or using the toilet.
descriptions.medium: Pain, bleeding, and swelling of the nodes repeat more often, and sitting for long periods becomes difficult.
descriptions.hard: Nodes hurt strongly, may prolapse or bleed. Hygiene, rest, and bleeding control are needed.
descriptions.veryHard: Pain is sharp, bleeding is frequent, and inflammation or thrombosis of the nodes is possible.
descriptions.critical: Severe bleeding, infection, or acute thrombosis with sharp pain and weakness are possible.

descriptions.light: Leakage occurs when coughing, laughing, moving sharply, or waiting too long.
descriptions.medium: Urges become sudden, bladder control is harder, and frequent toilet access is needed.
descriptions.hard: Leakage or loss of control repeats often, the skin becomes irritated, and sleep may be interrupted.
descriptions.veryHard: Control is almost absent, requiring pads, hygiene, and regular changes of clothing or underwear.

descriptions.light: It is sometimes difficult to hold gas or an urgent need to use the toilet.
descriptions.medium: Sudden loss of control is possible, especially during stress, diarrhea, or physical strain.
descriptions.hard: Control is often impaired, requiring hygiene, spare clothes, and toilet access.
descriptions.veryHard: Loss of control may be regular, the skin becomes irritated, and the risk of infection and dehydration rises during diarrhea.

descriptions.light: Stool is often unstable, the stomach rumbles, and an urgent need may appear after eating.
descriptions.medium: Frequent bowel movements cause weakness, thirst, cramps, and a constant need for water access.
descriptions.hard: The body quickly loses fluid and salts, with possible dizziness, abdominal pain, and exhaustion.
descriptions.veryHard: Diarrhea lasts a long time, weight and strength drop, and the risk of dehydration is high.
descriptions.critical: Dangerous dehydration is possible: dryness, confusion, sharp weakness, fast pulse, or fainting.

descriptions.light: Bowel movements are rare, the abdomen feels heavy, and water, movement, and normal food are needed.
descriptions.medium: Bloating, pain, and nausea appear, and straining during toilet use becomes frequent.
descriptions.hard: Severe constipation causes cramps, weakness, hemorrhoids, or fissures.
descriptions.veryHard: The bowel works very slowly, pain and bloating last a long time, and fecal impaction is possible.

descriptions.light: The abdomen reacts to stress or food with bloating, cramps, or unstable stool.
descriptions.medium: Pain and toilet urges repeat often, and symptoms depend on food, nerves, and sleep.
descriptions.hard: Cramps, diarrhea, or constipation can sharply disrupt the day, with exhaustion and anxiety from symptoms.
descriptions.veryHard: The bowel reacts to almost any stress or unsuitable food, and pain and instability last a long time.

en.name: Missing One Kidney
en.description: Has only one functioning kidney. The body may work stably, but dehydration, toxins, infections, and dangerous medications create higher risk.

descriptions.light: May cause pulling pain in the lower abdomen or discomfort during movement.
descriptions.medium: Pain increases, the cycle may become irregular, and nausea or pressure may appear.
descriptions.hard: The cyst may cause sharp pain, limit movement, and cause weakness or bloody discharge.
descriptions.veryHard: Rupture or torsion is possible: sharp pain, nausea, cold sweat, and severe weakness.
descriptions.critical: Rupture or torsion may cause internal bleeding, shock, or an acute abdomen.

en.name: Congenital Heart Defect with Severe Limitations

descriptions.light: The heart handles exertion poorly, and fatigue or shortness of breath appears faster.
descriptions.medium: Pulse, breathing, and endurance become unstable after stress or physical activity.
descriptions.hard: Bluish lips, chest pain, dizziness, and a sharp drop in strength are possible.
descriptions.veryHard: The heart has little reserve, and shortness of breath or weakness may appear even at rest.
descriptions.critical: Acute heart failure, fainting, severe lack of oxygen, or dangerous rhythm disturbance are possible.

descriptions.light: The feet tire faster after walking or standing, and the heels or arches sometimes hurt.
descriptions.medium: Pain in the feet spreads to the knees or back, and long standing is tolerated worse.
descriptions.hard: Feet hurt strongly after exertion, gait changes, and the joints and lower back overload quickly.
descriptions.veryHard: Pain and foot deformity occur often, requiring proper shoes, insoles, and regular rest.

descriptions.light: The feet are positioned incorrectly, gait is different, and fatigue appears faster after exertion.
descriptions.medium: Pain in the feet, knees, or lower legs worsens after walking or running.
descriptions.hard: The deformity noticeably changes gait, movement becomes less stable, and shoes cause rubbing quickly.
descriptions.veryHard: The feet are severely deformed, pain and instability repeat often, and support or orthopedic shoes are needed.

en.name: Leg Prosthesis
en.description: Uses a leg prosthesis. Movement depends on the condition of the prosthesis, its fastening, the skin of the stump, even ground, and the ability to rest.

en.name: Arm Prosthesis
en.description: Uses an arm prosthesis. Fine movements, grip, strength, and tool use depend on the type and condition of the prosthesis.

en.name: Glass Eye
en.description: One eye is artificial, so vision is only available from one side. Depth, distance, and movement on the missing-eye side are harder to judge.

en.name: Hearing Aid
en.description: Uses a hearing aid. Sound perception depends on the battery, moisture, surrounding noise, and device condition.

en.name: Pacemaker
en.description: Has a pacemaker that supports heart rhythm. Strong impacts to the chest, electromagnetic interference, or device malfunction can be dangerous.

en.name: Insulin Pump
en.description: Uses an insulin pump. The condition depends on insulin supply, battery, catheter, skin cleanliness, and regular blood sugar control.

descriptions.light: The bony growth causes little trouble and sometimes creates pressure or local discomfort.
descriptions.medium: If the growth increases, pain, pressure on tissues, or limited movement nearby may appear.
descriptions.hard: An osteoma may press on nerves, vessels, or sinuses, causing pain, numbness, or headache.

descriptions.light: A soft fatty lump under the skin usually does not hurt and grows slowly.
descriptions.medium: The lipoma grows, may press on tissues, rub against clothing, or interfere with movement.
descriptions.hard: A large growth hurts, becomes inflamed, or presses on nerves, causing numbness or discomfort.

descriptions.light: There is a soft mass on the neck that sometimes presses or interferes with turning the head.
descriptions.medium: The cyst may grow, hurt, rub against clothing, or become inflamed.
descriptions.hard: Inflammation causes severe pain, swelling, fever, or difficulty swallowing.
descriptions.veryHard: Neck swelling becomes significant and may press on the throat, vessels, or airways.

descriptions.light: Sweating is stronger than normal, especially on the palms, feet, or underarms.
descriptions.medium: Sweating appears even without exertion, clothes become wet quickly, and the skin becomes irritated.
descriptions.hard: Constantly moist skin causes rubbing, odor, fungal infections, and the need for frequent hygiene.
descriptions.veryHard: Sweating is almost uncontrolled, with possible dehydration, skin cracks, infections, and severe discomfort.

descriptions.light: Sweat has a strong odor even after ordinary exertion.
descriptions.medium: The odor returns quickly after washing and worsens from stress, heat, or synthetic clothing.
descriptions.hard: The skin is often irritated, the odor is persistent, and frequent hygiene, clean clothing, and infection control are needed.
descriptions.veryHard: The odor almost does not disappear, and chronic irritation, fungal lesions, and painful skin cracks are possible.

descriptions.light: Bad breath appears from time to time, more often after sleep or food.
descriptions.medium: The smell lasts longer and may be linked to teeth, gums, the stomach, or dry mouth.
descriptions.hard: The smell is persistent, gums may bleed, teeth may hurt, and dryness or an unpleasant taste appears.
descriptions.veryHard: Strong odor comes with gum inflammation, cavities, pain, or digestive problems.

en.name: Missing Teeth
en.description: Most or all teeth are missing. Chewing hard food is difficult, speech may change, and gums are easily rubbed.

descriptions.light: Eyes dry out quickly, with burning or a gritty feeling after wind, dust, or long reading.
descriptions.medium: Burning and tearing repeat often, light and smoke irritate the eyes, and vision may temporarily blur.
descriptions.hard: Dryness is constant, the eyes become red and painful, and it is difficult to look at small details or bright light for long.
descriptions.veryHard: The cornea is easily irritated, with possible cracks, severe pain, light sensitivity, and sudden vision worsening without drops.

descriptions.light: Fingers sometimes go numb or tingle after hand work or prolonged gripping.
descriptions.medium: Numbness, pain, and weakness in the hand repeat more often, and fine movements become harder.
descriptions.hard: The hand tires quickly, objects may slip out, and pain worsens at night or after exertion.
descriptions.veryHard: Numbness and weakness are almost constant, finger precision drops sharply, and nerve damage is possible.

descriptions.light: The elbow hurts after gripping, lifting things, or repeating hand movements.
descriptions.medium: Pain spreads into the forearm, grip weakens, and twisting, pulling, or using tools becomes harder.
descriptions.hard: Even light strain on the arm causes sharp pain, and breaks, fixation, and rest are needed.
descriptions.veryHard: Pain remains even at rest, the arm weakens quickly, and repeated movement sharply worsens the condition.

descriptions.light: The heel hurts after long walking or standing, especially during the first steps in the morning.
descriptions.medium: Pain becomes more frequent, gait changes, and the foot tires quickly without soft footwear.
descriptions.hard: Every step may cause sharp heel pain, requiring breaks, insoles, or support.
descriptions.veryHard: Pain is almost constant, normal weight-bearing is difficult, and exertion quickly worsens the condition.

descriptions.light: The tendon hurts after running, climbing stairs, or long walking.
descriptions.medium: Pain and stiffness appear more often, the calf tires quickly, and pushing off with the foot becomes harder.
descriptions.hard: The tendon swells and hurts sharply during movement, requiring rest, cold treatment, and limited load.
descriptions.veryHard: Every step is painful, the tendon may be partially damaged, and a sudden movement can cause rupture.

descriptions.light: Partial damage causes pain and weakness while walking, and pushing off with the foot is limited.
descriptions.medium: The foot almost cannot push off normally, gait is limping, and fixation is needed.
descriptions.hard: A complete or near-complete rupture sharply disrupts walking, and swelling and pain last a long time.
descriptions.veryHard: The leg cannot handle a normal step without fixation or support, and repeated load worsens the injury.

descriptions.light: The toe hurts when pressed or in tight shoes, and the skin near the nail becomes red.
descriptions.medium: Pain worsens while walking, with swelling, irritation, or mild inflammation.
descriptions.hard: The toe may produce pus, every step is painful, and cleanliness, dressing, and reduced load are needed.
descriptions.veryHard: The infection spreads, the toe swells and hurts severely, and fever or tissue damage is possible.

descriptions.light: The nail changes color, becomes thicker or brittle, but almost does not hurt.
descriptions.medium: The infection spreads to several nails, shoes rub, and discomfort and odor appear.
descriptions.hard: Nails crumble, the surrounding skin is irritated, and walking may be painful due to shoe pressure.
descriptions.veryHard: The fungus affects nails and skin, with possible cracks, inflammation, pain, and risk of secondary infection.

descriptions.light: The skin is periodically dry, itchy, and red after cold, stress, or irritants.
descriptions.medium: Itching becomes more frequent, the skin cracks, and painful or weeping areas appear.
descriptions.hard: Inflammation interferes with sleep, hands or folds hurt and itch, and cracks become easily contaminated.
descriptions.veryHard: The skin is severely damaged, itching is almost constant, and infections, bleeding cracks, and exhaustion are possible.

descriptions.light: After contact with an irritant, the skin becomes red, itchy, or burns.
descriptions.medium: The reaction becomes stronger: blisters, swelling, cracks, or weeping areas appear.
descriptions.hard: The skin hurts and is easily damaged; the irritant must be avoided, and affected areas need cleanliness and protection.
descriptions.veryHard: Inflammation covers large areas, with possible infections, severe swelling, and open painful wounds.

descriptions.light: Itchy spots or hives appear on the skin from time to time.
descriptions.medium: The rash repeats often, itching interferes with sleep, and the skin reacts to food, cold, heat, or stress.
descriptions.hard: Hives may cover large areas, itching is exhausting, and swelling of the lips or eyelids is possible.
descriptions.veryHard: Reactions are strong and unpredictable, swelling repeats, and medication and trigger control are needed.
descriptions.critical: Throat swelling or an anaphylactic reaction with breathing difficulty and falling blood pressure is possible.

descriptions.light: Inflamed skin eruptions are present and sometimes hurt or become irritated.
descriptions.medium: There are more eruptions, painful nodules appear, and the skin inflames easily and leaves marks.
descriptions.hard: Deep inflammation hurts, may produce pus, leave scars, and requires cleanliness and treatment.
descriptions.veryHard: Large painful nodules and pustules repeat often, with possible scarring, swelling, and secondary infection.

descriptions.light: The face reddens easily after heat, stress, spicy food, or cold.
descriptions.medium: Redness lasts longer, the skin burns, and visible vessels or small inflammations appear.
descriptions.hard: Facial skin hurts and reacts strongly to temperature, sunlight, smoke, or alcohol.
descriptions.veryHard: Inflammation is persistent, with possible swelling, skin thickening, eye irritation, and severe burning.

descriptions.light: Hair falls out in patches or noticeably thins, but the scalp barely causes discomfort.
descriptions.medium: Hair loss spreads, and the skin may itch or become sensitive to cold and sunlight.
descriptions.hard: Hair is lost over large areas, and the scalp needs protection from sun, cold, and irritation.

en.name: Conjoined Twin Condition
en.description: Is physically connected to another body or has consequences of such a connection. Movement, sleep, hygiene, and medical risks depend on the fusion site and shared organs.

en.name: Polydactyly
en.description: Has an extra finger or toe. Depending on the form, it may barely interfere or may affect grip, footwear, or movement precision.

en.name: Syndactyly
en.description: Several fingers or toes are fused together. This may limit fine motor skills, grip, balance, or shoe comfort.

en.name: Heterochromia
en.description: The eyes have different colors or partially different coloring. By itself this usually does not interfere, but in some cases it may come with eye sensitivity.

en.name: Dextrocardia
en.description: The heart is located on the right side. The condition may be stable, but injuries, surgery, or diagnosis must account for the unusual organ position.

en.name: Situs Inversus
en.description: Internal organs are arranged in a mirror-image layout. It may not interfere in everyday life, but pain, injuries, and medical help may be harder to interpret.

descriptions.light: Joints are overly flexible, skin stretches easily, and sprains or bruises appear more often.
descriptions.medium: Joints may twist or partially slip out of place, and pain and fatigue repeat after exertion.
descriptions.hard: Ligaments are unstable, and dislocations, pain, and soft tissue injuries happen often. Wounds may heal more slowly.
descriptions.veryHard: Joints are very unstable, skin and vessels are fragile, and movement requires caution and fixation.
descriptions.critical: In the vascular form, dangerous ruptures of vessels or organs may occur, with sharp pain, weakness, and internal bleeding.

descriptions.light: After an infection, tingling or weakness appears in the legs or arms.
descriptions.medium: Weakness increases, walking becomes harder, reflexes decrease, and pain or numbness is possible.
descriptions.hard: Muscles weaken quickly, making it difficult to climb, hold objects, or stand.
descriptions.veryHard: Paralysis may rise higher, affecting swallowing, speech, or breathing.
descriptions.critical: Respiratory failure or sudden disruption of heart function and blood pressure is possible. Urgent medical support is needed.

descriptions.light: Muscles tire quickly, eyelids may droop, and vision sometimes doubles.
descriptions.medium: Weakness worsens after exertion, and chewing, speaking, or holding the head up becomes harder.
descriptions.hard: Muscle strength is unstable, swallowing and speech may worsen, and medication and rest are needed.
descriptions.veryHard: Weakness may affect breathing muscles, swallowing becomes dangerous, and strength drops quickly.
descriptions.critical: A myasthenic crisis can disrupt breathing. Urgent help and airway control are needed.

descriptions.light: Mucus is thicker than normal, with more frequent cough, shortness of breath, or digestion problems.
descriptions.medium: The lungs and intestines work unstably, requiring medication, water, high-calorie food, and airway clearance.
descriptions.hard: Lung infections repeat, coughing is exhausting, weight drops, and digestion worsens.
descriptions.veryHard: Breathing is difficult, mucus is thick, and the body weakens quickly from infections and lack of nutrients.
descriptions.critical: Respiratory failure, severe lung infection, or sudden exhaustion of the body is possible.

descriptions.light: Fatigue, paleness, or pain appears periodically after cold, stress, or dehydration.
descriptions.medium: Pain crises repeat, bones and joints may hurt severely, and water and warmth are needed.
descriptions.hard: Crises are exhausting, with possible shortness of breath, jaundice, infections, and weakness from lack of oxygen.
descriptions.veryHard: Pain is long-lasting and severe, and organs may suffer from impaired blood flow.
descriptions.critical: Acute chest syndrome, stroke, sepsis, or dangerous oxygen drop in the blood is possible.

descriptions.light: Involuntary movements, mild clumsiness, or coordination changes appear.
descriptions.medium: Movements become sharper, precise hand work becomes harder, and balance or swallowing problems may appear.
descriptions.hard: Involuntary movements, falls, spasms, and speech problems become frequent.
descriptions.veryHard: The body has little control over movement, swallowing is dangerous, and weight and strength drop quickly.
descriptions.critical: Severe exhaustion, food aspiration, pneumonia, or dangerous injuries from loss of movement control are possible.

descriptions.light: Constant hunger and low muscle tone make food control and endurance harder.
descriptions.medium: Hunger becomes obsessive, weight rises easily, and sleepiness, weakness, and metabolic problems appear.
descriptions.hard: Obesity, weak muscles, and hormonal disorders noticeably overload the heart, breathing, and joints.
descriptions.veryHard: Severe obesity, sleep apnea, swelling, and low endurance sharply worsen physical condition.
descriptions.critical: Dangerous complications from overeating, respiratory failure, heart issues, or sudden metabolic disruption are possible.

descriptions.light: The body shows signs of premature aging: thin skin, weakness, growth problems, and joint issues.
descriptions.medium: Vessels and bones are more fragile, and fatigue, joint pain, and limited movement appear quickly.
descriptions.hard: The heart and vessels age faster, with possible shortness of breath, weakness, chest pain, or high blood pressure.
descriptions.veryHard: The body is highly vulnerable to cardiovascular complications, and bones and joints are easily overloaded.
descriptions.critical: Heart attack, stroke, or acute vascular damage with sharp pain, weakness, or loss of consciousness is possible.

descriptions.light: Parts of the body grow unevenly, with possible asymmetry, joint pain, or gait problems.
descriptions.medium: Excess tissue growth interferes with movement, skin and joints overload, and clothing or shoes may rub.
descriptions.hard: Deformities may press on nerves, vessels, or organs, causing pain, swelling, and instability.
descriptions.veryHard: Movement is strongly limited, tissues are overloaded, and the risk of clots, infections, and injuries increases.
descriptions.critical: Thrombosis, embolism, severe infection, or dangerous organ compression is possible.

descriptions.light: The legs are partially fused or severely deformed, and movement is sharply limited.
descriptions.medium: The deformity affects the pelvis, legs, and urinary system, requiring support or assistive devices for movement.
descriptions.hard: Serious problems with the kidneys, bladder, pelvis, and circulation are possible.
descriptions.veryHard: Lower body organs work unstably, with high risk of infections, pain, and impaired urine flow.
descriptions.critical: Kidney failure, severe infection, or acute failure of pelvic organs is possible.

descriptions.light: Fatigue, headache, irritability, or abdominal pain appears after long exposure to lead.
descriptions.medium: Weakness, nausea, tremor, and concentration problems repeat more often.
descriptions.hard: The nervous system and blood formation are more affected: numbness, anemia, abdominal pain, and confusion are possible.
descriptions.veryHard: Poisoning accumulates, causing memory, coordination, blood pressure, kidney, or severe weakness problems.
descriptions.critical: Seizures, brain damage, acute kidney failure, or sharp disturbance of consciousness are possible.

descriptions.light: After exposure, nausea, weakness, headache, and increased skin sensitivity appear.
descriptions.medium: Weakness, vomiting, hair loss, and reduced immunity become noticeable.
descriptions.hard: Blood formation is disrupted, infections and bleeding happen more easily, and the body exhausts quickly.
descriptions.veryHard: Severe vomiting, skin burns, bleeding, fever, and a sharp drop in strength are possible.
descriptions.critical: A high radiation dose can cause failure of the bone marrow, intestines, or nervous system.

descriptions.light: Fingers are sensitive to cold, become numb, painful, or pale after low temperatures.
descriptions.medium: The skin cracks, with burning, tingling, and slow recovery after cold exposure.
descriptions.hard: Fingers swell, darken, or lose sensation, and movements become painful and imprecise.
descriptions.veryHard: Tissue may partially die, with blisters, severe pain, or risk of infection.

descriptions.light: After overheating, the body tolerates heat worse, and weakness and headache appear faster.
descriptions.medium: Heat, lack of water, or exertion can cause dizziness, nausea, and a sharp drop in strength.
descriptions.hard: Temperature regulation is unstable, with possible palpitations, confusion, trembling, and strong fatigue after heat.
descriptions.veryHard: Even moderate warmth can quickly worsen the condition: weakness, disorientation, dehydration, and risk of repeated overheating.

descriptions.light: Weakness, pain, or sensitivity remains at the bite site.
descriptions.medium: The limb may swell and hurt, strength drops quickly, and blood clotting is unstable.
descriptions.hard: Severe swelling, bleeding tendency, numbness, impaired movement, or pain after exertion are possible.
descriptions.veryHard: The venom may have damaged tissues, nerves, or the blood system; weakness and pain last a long time.

descriptions.light: The bite site hurts, reddens, and heals slowly.
descriptions.medium: The skin around the bite darkens, with swelling, burning, and risk of infection.
descriptions.hard: Tissue dies, the wound deepens, and cleanliness, dressings, and control of spread are needed.
descriptions.veryHard: Necrosis covers a larger area, pain is severe, and pus, fever, and muscle damage are possible.
descriptions.critical: Infection or necrosis can progress to sepsis or gangrene with a sharp deterioration of overall condition.

descriptions.light: After a tick bite, fever, headache, weakness, and muscle pain appear.
descriptions.medium: Fever returns in waves, with possible nausea, light sensitivity, severe headache, and fatigue.
descriptions.hard: Nervous system involvement causes dizziness, tremor, coordination problems, or confusion.
descriptions.veryHard: Paralysis, seizures, breathing or swallowing problems, or long-lasting weakness after infection are possible.
descriptions.critical: Acute brain involvement can cause coma, respiratory arrest, or lasting neurological damage.

descriptions.light: A ring-shaped rash, weakness, and body aches may appear after a tick bite.
descriptions.medium: Joint pain, fatigue, headache, and fever repeat in waves.
descriptions.hard: The infection can affect joints, nerves, or the heart, causing pain, numbness, and rhythm disturbances.
descriptions.veryHard: A long course causes severe fatigue, chronic joint pain, sensory problems, or concentration issues.

descriptions.light: Abdominal pain, bloating, itching, or unstable appetite may appear.
descriptions.medium: Parasites cause diarrhea, nausea, weight loss, weakness, and poor nutrient absorption.
descriptions.hard: Long infection causes exhaustion and may lead to anemia, dehydration, or strong cramps.
descriptions.veryHard: A large parasite load can disrupt bowel function and cause exhaustion, pain, and lack of nutrients.

descriptions.light: The skin itches strongly, especially at night, with small burrows or a rash.
descriptions.medium: Itching interferes with sleep, the skin is scratched, and small wounds appear easily.
descriptions.hard: Scratches become inflamed, with possible pustules, crusts, pain, and spreading rash.
descriptions.veryHard: Severe skin involvement causes constant itching, infections, insomnia, and exhaustion.

descriptions.light: Lice, itching, and irritation appear in the hair or on the skin.
descriptions.medium: Itching is frequent, the scalp is scratched, and wounds and poor sleep are possible.
descriptions.hard: Scratches may become infected, and the hair and skin need treatment, clean linen, and isolation of belongings.
descriptions.veryHard: Heavy infestation causes constant itching, skin inflammation, crusts, and risk of secondary infection.

descriptions.light: Round patches, itching, and flaking appear on the skin.
descriptions.medium: Patches spread, itching worsens, and the skin is irritated by clothing or sweat.
descriptions.hard: Fungal infection covers large areas, with possible cracks, weeping, and spread to other zones.
descriptions.veryHard: The skin is strongly inflamed, lesions return, and painful cracks and secondary infection are possible.

descriptions.light: Burning, tingling, and a painful rash appear in a strip along a nerve.
descriptions.medium: Pain becomes stronger, blisters are irritated, and movement or touch is unpleasant.
descriptions.hard: Nerve pain is sharp, sleep is disrupted, and the rash may become infected or heal slowly.
descriptions.veryHard: Pain may persist even after the rash disappears, with exhaustion and skin sensitivity.

descriptions.light: Begins with fever, cough, runny nose, red eyes, and weakness.
descriptions.medium: The rash spreads across the body, fever is high, light irritates the eyes, and strength drops quickly.
descriptions.hard: Severe fever, dehydration, pneumonia, ear infection, or strong exhaustion are possible.
descriptions.veryHard: The infection may affect the lungs or nervous system, causing shortness of breath, confusion, and severe weakness.
descriptions.critical: Encephalitis, severe pneumonia, seizures, or dangerous oxygen drop are possible.

descriptions.light: Mild fever, rash, swollen lymph nodes, and weakness appear.
descriptions.medium: Rash and joint pain become more noticeable, with possible headache, fatigue, and eye irritation.
descriptions.hard: Severe joint pain, inflammation, fever, or blood-related complications are possible.
descriptions.veryHard: In a pregnant person, infection can have severe consequences for the fetus; in adults, rare neurological complications are possible.

descriptions.light: The salivary glands swell, and the jaw or ear hurts; swallowing is unpleasant.
descriptions.medium: Fever, pain while chewing, and facial swelling last for several days.
descriptions.hard: Severe weakness, inflammation of the testes, pancreas, or pronounced pain are possible.
descriptions.veryHard: Rarely, the infection can affect the meninges, hearing, or cause long-lasting exhaustion.

descriptions.light: Sore throat, fever, a fine rash, and a red tongue appear.
descriptions.medium: Fever and throat pain become stronger, swallowing hurts, and the skin peels after the rash.
descriptions.hard: Without treatment, the heart, kidneys, or joints may be affected, with weakness and prolonged fever.
descriptions.veryHard: The infection may cause purulent complications, severe throat inflammation, swelling, and sharp exhaustion.
descriptions.critical: A toxic course or septic complications with falling blood pressure, confusion, and acute weakness are possible.

descriptions.light: Sore throat, weakness, fever, and a dense coating on the tonsils appear.
descriptions.medium: The coating in the throat interferes with swallowing, the neck may swell, and breathing becomes harder.
descriptions.hard: The toxin can affect the heart and nerves, causing weakness, arrhythmia, or swallowing problems.
descriptions.veryHard: Swelling and membranes in the throat can block breathing, and the heart works unstably.
descriptions.critical: Suffocation, toxic shock, myocarditis, or paralysis of respiratory muscles are possible.

descriptions.light: The cough is dry and persistent, and attacks become more frequent at night.
descriptions.medium: Coughing comes in series, breathing in is difficult after an attack, and vomiting and strong fatigue are possible.
descriptions.hard: Coughing attacks exhaust the body, causing shortness of breath, chest pain, and sleep disturbance.
descriptions.veryHard: Coughing may cause bluish skin, fainting, bleeding in the eyes, or severe exhaustion.
descriptions.critical: Breathing pauses, pneumonia, seizures, or dangerous oxygen drop are possible.

descriptions.light: Watery diarrhea, thirst, and weakness appear.
descriptions.medium: The body rapidly loses water and salts, with possible cramps, dizziness, and dry mouth.
descriptions.hard: Dehydration increases quickly, pulse is fast, skin is dry, and strength drops sharply.
descriptions.veryHard: Sunken eyes, cold skin, confusion, and almost absent urination are possible.
descriptions.critical: Critical dehydration can cause shock, kidney failure, coma, or death without immediate rehydration.

descriptions.light: Fever, headache, weakness, and abdominal pain gradually appear.
descriptions.medium: Fever lasts a long time, appetite drops, and diarrhea or constipation and strong fatigue are possible.
descriptions.hard: The infection drains the body, with possible delirium, rash, dehydration, and severe abdominal pain.
descriptions.veryHard: The intestine may become dangerously inflamed, fever is high, and consciousness is unstable.
descriptions.critical: Intestinal bleeding, intestinal perforation, sepsis, or shock are possible.

descriptions.light: Severe headache, fever, light sensitivity, and neck stiffness appear at the beginning.
descriptions.medium: Pain and fever increase, with possible nausea, sleepiness, confusion, and sensitivity to sound.
descriptions.hard: Inflammation of the meninges causes neck rigidity, delirium, seizures, or sharp deterioration.
descriptions.veryHard: Consciousness is unstable, with possible repeated seizures, breathing problems, or severe brain swelling.
descriptions.critical: Coma, sepsis, respiratory arrest, brain damage, or death without urgent help are possible.

descriptions.light: The infection already affects the whole body: fever, weakness, chills, or fast pulse appear.
descriptions.medium: The condition worsens quickly, with possible confusion, shortness of breath, low blood pressure, and severe weakness.
descriptions.hard: Organs begin working unstably, the skin is cold or mottled, and urination decreases.
descriptions.veryHard: Septic shock can cause a sharp blood pressure drop, disturbed consciousness, and organ failure.
descriptions.critical: Multiple organ failure, coma, circulatory arrest, or death without immediate intensive care are possible.

descriptions.light: Tissue hurts, darkens, or loses sensation after injury, infection, or impaired blood flow.
descriptions.medium: The affected area swells, smells bad, darkens, and pain or numbness worsens.
descriptions.hard: Tissues die, infection may spread, and fever, weakness, and severe pain appear.
descriptions.veryHard: Necrosis spreads quickly, a limb or tissue area may require amputation, and the condition sharply drains the body.
descriptions.critical: Gas gangrene or widespread infection can cause sepsis, shock, and rapid threat to life.

descriptions.light: A painful lump with pus appears under the skin or in tissues.
descriptions.medium: Swelling, redness, and pain increase, and fever may appear.
descriptions.hard: The abscess grows, movement is painful, and infection may spread to nearby tissues.
descriptions.veryHard: The abscess is deep or large, with possible chills, severe weakness, pus discharge, and risk of phlegmon.
descriptions.critical: A purulent infection can progress to sepsis, especially with a deep abscess or weakened immunity.

descriptions.light: A painful pus-filled bump appears around a hair follicle.
descriptions.medium: The boil swells, hurts when touched, and the skin becomes red and tight.
descriptions.hard: The boil may grow, burst, leave a wound, and cause fever.
descriptions.veryHard: Several boils or one deep focus can cause severe pain, inflammation, and weakness.

descriptions.light: Purulent inflammation spreads through tissues, and the area hurts, reddens, and swells.
descriptions.medium: Pain and swelling grow quickly, the skin is hot, and fever and weakness are possible.
descriptions.hard: Inflammation is diffuse, borders are unclear, movement is painful, and infection may go deeper.
descriptions.veryHard: Tissues are badly affected, pain is sharp, and necrosis, pus tracks, and rapid exhaustion are possible.
